title: Quiescence in Concert: Composing Multi-Channel Time-Outs for IOCO
abstract: arXiv:2609.17640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In Model-Based Testing (MBT), test suites are generated automatically from a formal specification. The theory of testing real-time systems is rich, but often underused in practice, partly because applying the timed machinery demands expertise practitioners should not need. In prior work we addressed this for timed testing with a canonic lifting operator, which lets a modeller specify behaviour as plain labelled transition systems while implicitly obtaining the timed automata that express their quiescent behaviour (the explicit absence of outputs) with timers. This paper takes the next step: we show that our lifting still works when each component carries its own time-out on its own channel. This way, we introduce a multi-channel lifting. We show that it commutes with parallel composition, i.e. composing and lifting is the same as lifting first and then composing. translated_title: 协同静默：为IOCO组合多通道超时
translated_abstract: 在基于模型的测试（MBT）中，测试套件是从形式化规范自动生成的。实时系统测试理论十分丰富，但在实践中经常未被充分利用，部分原因是应用定时机制需要从业者本不应具备的专业知识。在之前的工作中，我们通过一个规范提升算子解决了定时测试的这一难题，该算子允许建模者将行为指定为普通的标记变迁系统，同时隐式地获得带有计时器、能够表达其静默行为（即输出的明确缺失）的定时自动机。本文迈出了下一步：我们证明了当每个组件在自己的通道上携带自己的超时机制时，我们的提升方法仍然有效。由此，我们引入了多通道提升。我们证明了该提升与并行组合可交换，即先组合再提升与先提升再组合的结果相同。我们还证明了MBT的相关机制得以保留：一致性、测试生成与……
tldr: 本文提出了一种多通道提升算子，使IOCO测试理论能够支持每个组件在各自通道上拥有独立超时机制的静默行为建模，并证明了该提升与并行组合可交换，同时保留了一致性与测试生成等MBT核心机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multi-channel lifting operator that extends quiescence modeling to systems where each component has its own time-out on its own channel, proving it commutes with parallel composition while preserving the MBT apparatus of conformance and test generation.
